worlds.label: Tim's personal timeline
worlds.description: Men in family can return to personal past; ripples personal events

events.label: Disappointing New Year party
events.description: At a dull New Year's Eve party, the teenagers kiss strangers at midnight because the family tradition says to - and Tim comes away feeling embarrassed and empty.

events.label: Dad reveals hereditary male-line travel
events.description: Tim's father sits him down and explains the family secret: the men of the family can walk back into moments of their own past and live them again.

events.label: Charlotte confessions still fail
events.description: Tim goes back to the summer before to try his luck with his sister's visiting friend, Charlotte - but even with second chances, she tells him she is not interested.

events.label: Tim moves to London; rooms with Harry
events.description: Tim leaves the family home in Cornwall to work as a lawyer in London, moving in with a volatile but endearing playwright roommate, Harry.

events.label: Meets Mary at Dans le Noir
events.description: At a restaurant where everyone eats in complete darkness, Tim falls into easy, laughing conversation with a young American called Mary, and is smitten.

events.label: Rewinds to save Harry play; Mary night erased
events.description: Tim rewinds to fix his friend Harry's disastrous opening night - but undoing the evening wipes out the night he first met Mary, who now has never known him.

events.label: Re-meets Mary at Kate Moss exhibition
events.description: After losing Mary to his own do-over, Tim learns where she will be and arranges to bump into her again at a photography exhibition.

events.label: Arrives before rival boyfriend
events.description: Tim uses one more jump to reach Mary's flat before another man can win her heart, and the two begin the relationship he has been chasing.

events.label: Marries Mary; declines later Charlotte
events.description: Tim and Mary marry in a small, rain-soaked church service that goes joyfully wrong, and he turns down a last chance with his old crush, Charlotte.

events.label: Daughter Posy born
events.description: Tim and Mary have their first child, a baby daughter they name Posy, and family life begins in earnest.

events.label: Prevents Kit Kat crash on Posy birthday
events.description: On Posy's birthday, Tim's sister Kit Kat is hurt in a car crash after a party, and Tim races back in time to stop it happening.

events.label: Pre-conception edit replaces Posy with a son
events.description: Tim learns the hard rule of his gift: change anything before a child is conceived, and that child is never born - Posy vanishes, replaced by a stranger son.

events.label: Restores crash timeline so Posy exists
events.description: To get his daughter back, Tim lets the car crash stand as history and instead helps Kit Kat recover in the present, accepting the accident happened.

events.label: Helps Kit Kat in present
events.description: Rather than rewriting the past, Tim supports his sister in the here and now, steering her away from the boyfriend who set the crash in motion.

events.label: Second child (son) born
events.description: Tim and Mary's second child, a baby boy, is born - and from this point his existence locks the family's past in place.

events.label: James terminal; cannot undo smoking without erasing kids
events.description: Tim's father is dying of cancer, and Tim discovers he cannot go back and stop the smoking that caused it, because undoing it would wipe out his children.

events.label: James teaches live-each-day-twice ethic
events.description: Tim's father shares his trick for happiness: live each ordinary day twice - once with all the tension and worry, and once noticing how sweet it really is.

events.label: Last shared memory travels with Dad
events.description: Father and son take their final walks together into the past, replaying a beach day from Tim's childhood before the chance is gone forever.

events.label: Dad dies; Tim stops rewinding grief
events.description: Tim's father dies, and Tim resists the urge to keep revisiting him by jumping backwards, learning instead to sit with his grief.

events.label: Third child conception cuts off Dad visits
events.description: When Mary falls pregnant with their third child, the family's past becomes fixed forever - Tim can never visit his late father again after the birth.

events.label: Chooses to live each day once
events.description: Tim makes peace with it, choosing to live every day just once, treasuring the small ordinary moments instead of endlessly re-running them.

events.label: Ordinary happiness without constant reset
events.description: The story closes on Tim's quiet realisation: life does not need fixing so much as it needs noticing - the loveliest days are the ordinary ones.

ruleEffects.effect: Pre-birth edit changes which child is conceived
Conception acts as soft consistency lock

outcome.summary: Personal mutable past used then renounced after conception butterfly and Dad death; Tim lives forward.
